Theorem
[Uniqueness---complete with bounded curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0384 1. appD:D.3\group Ricci Flow Existence

Let $g_i(t)$, $t\in [0,T_i)$, for $i=1,2$, be complete Ricci flows with bounded sectional curvature on a noncompact manifold. If $g_1(0)=g_2(0)$, then $g_1(t)=g_2(t)$ for $t<\min \{ T_1,T_2\} $.
